author: More Perfect Union
description:
A few pro-Israel billionaires are influencing the Trump administration’s Iran policy. No one has as much sway here as Miriam Adelson, who gave $250 million to Trump's campaign. That money buys a lot of influence, and she uses it to help make Israel the dominant power in the Middle East.
Producer: Trevor Hayes
Editor: @kungaaaaaaaa
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: The Billionaires Influencing Trump's Iran Policy

author: More Perfect Union
description:
The CEO of Northrup Grumman sees no desire at the Pentagon to decrease military industrial complex profits.

The CEO of Lockheed Martin says there's a "golden opportunity" right now.

The Trump administration is using the Iran War to pad defense industry profits.

Producers: Savannah Fortune and Lucy Dean Stockton

title: Top Weapons Contractor Execs Just Said The Quiet Part Out Loud
